newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU sugar panel to decide quarterly tenders.
newsitem.headline: EU sugar panel to decide quarterly tenders.

text.p: The European Union's sugar management committee will on Wednesday decide on quarterly production refunds in addition to the normal weekly tenders, an EU official said on Monday.

"The meeting will also be taken up with weekly tenders and standing refunds for white and raw sugar as well as syrup monthly refunds, non-annex 2 refunds and molasses import duties," the official said. --Brussels newsroom +32 2 287-6830
